title: Homer's Adventure
tagline: Homer's Adventure is an experimental agentic adventure game with dynamic generation for Web3.
description: Homer's Adventure is an old school turn based adventure game template. I It uses scripts to generate custom assets for your custom stories. The core idea is creators can expand the engine via agent Skills / Subagents to create custom stories and build economies both for the creators on top of web3.
how_its_made: The app is built on a custom template using Next js and Phaser as the game engine. This stack for chosen for its browser support and ease of 2D game development. Under the hood it uses Langchain deep agents and langgraph subagents for dice rolls and agentic adventure generation. It uses a script to generate assets for the game derived from the creators Skills. The voice and music are generated with 11labs and the images are generated with image-2.
